title: 第17章 危机前的宁静第18章 兽潮爆发妖兽来袭
content_zh:
杨贯峰从许广那里得知，这种情况发生在了逐虎王朝全境，甚至是接壤的周边王朝也有类似的情况。
因为逃难人数过多，柳叶和白石两个镇子的人口容纳量很快就到达了上限。
镇门已经关闭，不准外来人再进入其中。
难民们整日在镇子外边哭天喊地，跪倒了一排又一排，即便是军队拿刀架着驱赶都不肯走。
杨家这段时间也收留了很多逃难者，小松山下的那几个村落因杨家的存在没有被野兽侵扰。
但他们毕竟只是一个家族，和镇子的体量没法比，上下加在一起，能够收留三百人差不多就是极限。
兽患爆发的第二十八天，杨贯峰和余老换班，从矿产回到杨家。
议事堂内，杨飞云和杨霄雷向他汇报着情况。
“到今天，我们已经收了二百一十三户难民，目前都已经安置妥当。”杨飞云说道。
杨贯峰点点头问道：“还能继续收吗？”
“这个...财力和粮食方面，家里确实还能承担，地方吗，挤挤也还能行，就是没有那么多地给他们种。”
“不让他们种地，给他们发武器。”
“发武器？”杨飞云有些不解。
一旁的杨霄雷思量道：“大哥你的意思是，让他们成为外姓族兵？”
“不错，兽潮将至，攻势必然猛烈，这些人若是没有反抗的能力，最后都是死路一条！”
杨贯峰起身道：“这件事交给你们，下去和这些人讲明其中利害，愿意为我杨家所用者就加入族兵，兽潮之后，家里老人小孩便还能继续留在这里，不愿意的就自求多福，受灾期间我杨家管他们的口粮，但是之后，就哪来的回哪去。”
“是，大哥，我们知道了。”
杨贯峰意识到此次兽患对杨家来说是个大劫，但危险的同时，也是一个机会。
想要做大做强，首先就得有人才行。
小松山下方的那条河名叫临山河，前些日子余老带着灵睿，已经前去搭建了两座木桥，一座石桥。

杨家和山下的村落目前都在临山河北侧，杨贯峰原本的规划，就是要将这条河南面的区域也开辟出来，为杨家所用。
但当时没有那么多劳动力，就暂且搁置。
如今大量难民汇聚于此，正好吸收一波，待兽潮之后，他们就能够成为新生力量，为杨家开荒。
家主令传下去之后，难民们纷纷响应。
一听说以后也能留在此地，八成的青年男女表示愿意成为族兵。
经过这次兽患他们也是明白过来，还是得靠着大树才好乘凉。
对新兵的训练紧锣密鼓的展开，杨家这次也到了全民动员的程度，除了老人小孩，每个人都有任务在身。
小松山有个陡峭的山口，人很难行走，是野兽出山最频繁的区域。
杨灵睿带着本家族兵在这个地方守着。
杨家的其他修士，杨贯峰孤军深入，在小松山上观察兽患的最新动向。
余老在矿产上看护，矿产中产出的精矿，是杨家为数不多能够稳定换取灵晶的资源，不容有失。
灵虎和灵清二人，则守着禁地山崖。
前些日子野兽侵扰频繁，这几天却是消停了不少。
“仙师！探子回来了，今天依旧没有动静！”
族兵首领回到杨灵睿所在的营帐中报告道。
他名叫杨铁力，如果按血缘，算是杨灵睿的叔叔，小时候还抱过他。
不过现如今，杨灵睿已是踏上仙途，成为杨家供养的仙师，地位超然，远胜他们这样的凡人。
content_en:
Yang Guanfeng learned from Xu Guang that this situation occurred throughout the Zhuhu Dynasty, and even the neighboring dynasties that bordered it had similar situations.
Due to the large number of refugees, the population capacity of the towns of Willow Leaf and Shiraishi quickly reached its upper limit.
The town gate has been closed and outsiders are not allowed to enter again.
The refugees were crying and shouting outside the town all day long, kneeling in row after row, and refused to leave even when the army held knives to drive them away.
The Yang family also took in many refugees during this period. The villages at the foot of Xiaosong Mountain were not infested by wild beasts because of the presence of the Yang family.
But after all, they are just a family, and they are incomparable to the size of the town. Added together, they can accommodate 300 people, which is almost the limit.
On the twenty-eighth day after the animal epidemic broke out, Yang Guanfeng and Yu Lao changed shifts and returned to the Yang family from the mine.
In the meeting hall, Yang Feiyun and Yang Xiaolei reported the situation to him.
"As of today, we have taken in 213 households of refugees, and they have all been properly resettled," Yang Feiyun said.
Yang Guanfeng nodded and asked, "Can we continue to collect it?"
"This... in terms of financial resources and food, the family can indeed afford it. The space is still crowded, but it's just that there isn't that much land for them to grow."
“不让他们种地，给他们发武器。”
“发武器？”杨飞云有些不解。
Yang Xiaolei on the side thought about it: "Brother, what do you mean, let them become soldiers with foreign surnames?"
"Yes, the beast tide is coming, and the attack will be fierce. If these people don't have the ability to resist, they will die in the end!"
杨贯峰起身道：“这件事交给你们，下去和这些人讲明其中利害，愿意为我杨家所用者就加入族兵，兽潮之后，家里老人小孩便还能继续留在这里，不愿意的就自求多福，受灾期间我杨家管他们的口粮，但是之后，就哪来的回哪去。”
“是，大哥，我们知道了。”
Yang Guanfeng realized that this animal disaster was a catastrophe for the Yang family, but at the same time it was dangerous, it was also an opportunity.
想要做大做强，首先就得有人才行。
The river below Xiaosong Mountain is called Linshan River. A few days ago, Mr. Yu and Lingrui went there to build two wooden bridges and one stone bridge.
杨家和山下的村落目前都在临山河北侧，杨贯峰原本的规划，就是要将这条河南面的区域也开辟出来，为杨家所用。
But there was not that much labor force at that time, so we put it on hold for the time being.
Now a large number of refugees have gathered here, just in time to absorb a wave. After the beast wave, they can become a new force and open up wasteland for the Yang family.
After the family leader's order was passed down, the refugees responded one after another.
Once they heard that they could stay here in the future, 80% of the young men and women expressed their willingness to become clan soldiers.
After this animal infestation, they also realized that they still had to rely on big trees to enjoy the shade.
The training of new recruits is in full swing, and the Yang family has reached the level of mobilization of the whole people this time. Except for the elderly and children, everyone has a task to perform.
There is a steep mountain pass in Xiaosong Mountain, which is difficult for people to walk. It is an area where wild beasts come out most frequently.
Yang Lingrui led his family soldiers to guard this place.
Other monks from the Yang family, Yang Guanfeng, went deep alone to observe the latest trends in the beast problem on Xiaosong Mountain.
Mr. Yu is taking care of the minerals. The concentrate produced in the minerals is one of the few resources of the Yang family that can be stably exchanged for spiritual crystals, and there is no room for loss.
灵虎和灵清二人，则守着禁地山崖。
In the past few days, there were frequent wild beast intrusions, but these days they have subsided a lot.
"Master Immortal! The spy is back, there is still no movement today!"
The leader of the clan soldiers returned to the camp where Yang Lingrui was and reported.
His name is Yang Tieli. According to blood relationship, he is Yang Lingrui's uncle. He even hugged him when he was a child.
But now, Yang Lingrui has embarked on the path of immortality and has become an immortal master supported by the Yang family, with a transcendent status.Far better than mere mortals like them.
